verdict: Ads are running, but the lead capture path is broken and being fixed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Ads account spent $591.94, generated 124 clicks, and recorded zero leads — not because interest is absent, but because the conversion path itself is not working. This is a structural issue, not a performance slump: the connection between a click or a call and a recorded lead is broken, meaning results are under-reported and spending is running without measurable return. On the positive side, local interest is rising — direction requests through your Google Business Profile spiked 140% this week, pointing to real people looking for you nearby. A full end-to-end test of the lead capture and payment paths is scheduled to complete by August 31st, and new paid landing pages go live at the same time; next period you should see leads recording for the first time and a clearer picture of what the ads are actually producing.
